mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) and a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals an impending monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and UNRATE < 4.5 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts (HOUST > 1000) indicate sustained consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST > 1000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically precedes negative equity market returns due to reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high GDP (GDPC1 > 16000) and elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signals an inflationary economic expansion, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 16000 and CPIAUCSL > 230 (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate).

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates immediate accommodative monetary policy, boosting investor sentiment and producing positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).
